name: Outbound LinkedIn DM Rubric for xAI Roles
description: Score an outbound LinkedIn DM inviting a candidate to consider an xAI role. Input = {candidate_profile, job_description, message}. Output = JSON with per-section scores, comments, and total.

sections.title: Relevance & Fit
criteria: +4 references role-specific skills/keywords from the JD (model type, infra, domain, stack)

sections.title: Personalization
criteria: +3 calls out domain match (e.g., LLM infra, RL, safety, networking, tutoring domain)
penalties: -2 generic mass-mail tone ('Dear Sir/Madam', 'To whom it may concern')

sections.title: Value Proposition
criteria: +4 explains why xAI/this role is attractive (mission, impact, tech stack, scope)

sections.title: Call to Action
criteria: +4 clear, low-friction CTA (short chat or link to apply)

sections.title: Structure & Clarity
penalties: -2 overlong (>180 words) or wall of text

global_penalties: -4 hallucinated facts about candidate or role
scoring_notes: Score each section 0–weight. Apply penalties where relevant (can drive section below zero but not below -weight). Sum sections plus penalties to total. Return JSON: {section_scores: {id: {score, comments}}, penalties: [...applied...], total_score}.
